broken.why: PVE has no DELETE on the config sub-resource; a VM is destroyed at /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}.

refuted.why: PVE registers only PUT on the ACL collection; the spec names a collection so the shared factory type-checks.
The spec points `path` at the collection so the read works; ceph-daemon.ts overrides `delete` because DELETE is not registered there.
PVE registers only PUT on the flags collection; ceph-flag.ts documents its create as unreachable.
